steps.caption: Team & Company
steps.narration: Your profile is how you appear to your crew and on the schedule. Let's set it up.

steps.caption: My profile tab
steps.narration: On Team and Company, the first tab is My profile.

steps.caption: Name
steps.narration: Name is what your crew sees next to your jobs and visits.

steps.caption: Title
steps.narration: Title is your job at the company. Type it the way you want it shown.

steps.caption: Mobile
steps.narration: Mobile is your own cell number. We'll type a demo number here.

steps.caption: Role
steps.narration: Role shows what you may do in the CRM. You can't change your own role here.

steps.caption: Save profile
steps.narration: When it looks right, choose Save profile.

steps.caption: Profile saved
steps.narration: The CRM says Profile saved, and takes you back to Home.

steps.caption: Your name opens it
steps.narration: To change it later, click your name at the bottom of the menu.

steps.caption: Saved details
steps.narration: Your title is saved, and the mobile number is stored with its country code.

steps.caption: Menu: Team & Company
steps.narration: You'll also find My profile under Team and Company in the menu.

youtube.title: How to set up your profile | ConstructHUB CRM
youtube.description: A short walkthrough of My profile in the ConstructHUB CRM. You will set your name, title and mobile number, see your role, and save. Then you will see how to open your profile again from the menu.
